[[File:Internet-map-1024.jpg|thumbnail|An artistic illustration of the major nodes and connections between them on the internet as of 2005]]
The Internet is a global [[computer network]].

It connects organisations, public and private, as well as individuals across the world via protocols specified by '''the Internet Architecture Board (IAB)'''. 

'''The Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN)''' coordinates address and namespace assignment.
